| Difficulty = 1

{{recipe}}

'''Yogi tea''' is a spiced tea similar to [[Cookbook:Chai Tea|chai]]. It is also the brand name of a line of herbal teas.

== Ingredients ==
* 15 whole [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
* 20 black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]]
* 3 sticks of [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 20 green [[Cookbook:Cardamom|cardamom]] pods (crushed or split)
* 8 or more ¼-inch (0.75cm) slices of fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] root
* ½ tsp black [[Cookbook:Tea|tea]] (decaffinated black tea is acceptable)

== Procedure ==
# Bring 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] (about 2 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]]) water to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in 3–4-quart [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|pot]]. 
# Add cloves and boil for 1 minute. 
# Add peppercorns, cinnamon, cardamom pods and ginger.
# Cover and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] gently for at least 30 minutes. For best flavor, cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 2–3 hours.
# Remove from heat and add tea.
# Let cool. 
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] ingredients from the finished tea. 
# When ready to drink, sweeten to taste with [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] or [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]. Add [[Cookbook:Soy Milk|soy milk]] or dairy [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]].
